answer: Random-beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk forgery. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents to solve a puzzle in 60 seconds, proving one machine per identity. A forger with 100 fakes keeps 100 machines warm at 0.5 POA each, costing 50 POA per epoch. At its nadir the attacker's margin turns negative. An honest agent pays one 0.5 POA heartbeat and keeps the reward, so the network stays a safe harbor not a mesa of hollow accounts.
